notes: Marathon Petroleum (Findlay, OH) 10-K reports 60,350 employees at Dec. 31, 2018, including 40,230 in the Speedway retail segment. Speedway was sold to 7-Eleven (Irving, TX) on May 14, 2021, inside the last grant year, so the FY2021 payment may have landed after the sale; JobsOhio metrics show 1,175 jobs retained at Enon.

Founded in Columbus in 1999 by Kara Trott and headquartered in Dublin, OH; Great Hill Partners bought a majority stake in 2017 and Warburg Pincus made a significant investment in November 2020 (PE owners). Form 5500 counts and 1,099 retained jobs put the company at roughly 1,000 to 2,000 employees in the grant years.

Privately held poultry processor based in Park Ridge, IL, founded 1973, with about 14,000 employees per Forbes; Form 5500 for Koch Foods, Inc. shows 5,215 participants in 2019 and 6,790 in 2023. The grant supported a $220 million expansion of the Fairfield, OH plant announced in 2021 (Journal-News).

Magna Seating of America (Novi, MI) is a subsidiary of Magna International, Aurora, Ontario, whose 2021 Annual Information Form (filed with the 40-F) reports more than 158,000 employees. JobsOhio metrics show 390 jobs retained at the Ohio seating plant.

The University of Dayton Research Institute files under the university's EIN; UD is a 501(c)(3) with about $775 million revenue in FY2019 (ProPublica). Form 5500 participants (which include former employees with balances) run 4,500 to 6,200, so the active headcount is likely under 5,000 but close to the line.

Privately held Novi, MI distributor of medical supplies (syringes, gloves, COVID tests) founded in 2013 by Josh and Darryl Kaplan and Max Cornfield alongside SLI Automotive; named a Michigan SBDC Best Small Business in 2022 and put into receivership in 2025 (Crain's Detroit). No Ohio project or JobsOhio release was found, and LinkedIn lists 2-10 employees, so the FY2020 payment may relate to pandemic supply purchasing rather than a site project.

Project LLC for the 1-million-square-foot spec building at Turnpike Commerce Center in Shalersville, developed by Geis Companies (Streetsboro, OH, founded 1967) with capital partner Stonemont Financial Group (SFG, Atlanta); REjournals reports the project received a JobsOhio OSIP grant. LinkedIn lists Geis at 501-1,000 employees, a self-reported range.

Chicago-based accounting firm (then BDO USA, LLP; now a P.C., which is why the EIN shows as an SEC registrant); Form 5500 participants of 9,873 in 2019 and Forbes' 12,000 employees put it well over 5,000. The grant went to a Columbus office; JobsOhio metrics show 0 jobs retained, so this was a new-jobs project.

Kohl's FY2022 10-K reports an average of about 97,000 associates and lists a 1.3 million square foot e-fulfillment center opened in Etna, OH in 2021, the likely subject of the grant. Headquarters Menomonee Falls, WI.

Kao USA (formerly the Andrew Jergens Company, Cincinnati) has been owned by Tokyo-based Kao Corporation since 1988; Kao reports about 33,400 consolidated employees. Kao USA's own Form 5500 shows 949 participants in 2019 and JobsOhio metrics show 521 jobs retained at the Cincinnati plant that received a Revitalization Grant.

501(c)(3) county economic development corporation in Jackson, OH with revenue of $657,000 (2019) to $1.4 million (2020) and an executive director paid about $73,000, consistent with a staff of a few people. The Revitalization Grant was passed through to a local site project (JobsOhio metrics show 0 jobs retained).

Mason, OH warehouse-automation maker founded in 2001; during the FY2016 grant year it was owned by private-equity firm Permira (since 2012) and had about 3,200 employees worldwide (Transport Topics, July 2016). Honeywell agreed to buy it for $1.5 billion in July 2016 and closed in August 2016, after the grant year.

Milacron Holdings' 2015 10-K reports headquarters in Cincinnati, OH and 5,551 employees worldwide; the company traces to 1860 in Cincinnati. It went public in June 2015 with CCMP Capital as majority owner; the EDGAR HQ state of IN reflects the November 2019 acquisition by Hillenbrand (Batesville, IN), after the grant year.

LuK is a Schaeffler Group brand (Herzogenaurach, Germany), which reported roughly 90,000 employees in its 2017 annual report and 120,000 in 2023. JobsOhio metrics show 1,767 jobs retained at the LuK USA transmission-component plant in Wooster.

Napoleon, OH developer of the Land Air business park and a 100,000 square foot spec building near Toledo Express Airport (Toledo Blade, Dec. 2017); JobsOhio metrics list Revitalization Grant, Revitalization Loan and OSIP spec development with 0 jobs retained. No headcount or principal owner source was found (the Blade article is paywalled and no LinkedIn or company site turned up), so the size is a best guess for a single-purpose development LLC.

Privately held home-improvement chain headquartered in Eau Claire, WI, founded 1958, with about 45,000 employees per Forbes; Form 5500 shows 36,286 participants in 2019. The Ohio project is not in the JobsOhio metrics extract.

Independent Cleveland product-design and innovation firm founded in 1972 by John Nottingham and John Spirk; Form 5500 participants under 75 and 53 retained jobs put it under 100 employees. The $1.5 million was a Research & Development Grant, unusual for a firm this size.

SP Office reads as the Scioto Peninsula office entity: JobsOhio's success story says The Peninsula Office (300 Rush Alley, Columbus, $29.2 million) was developed by the Daimler Group with a $1.5 million Ohio Site Inventory Program investment, matching this recipient's $1.5 million and 2020 EIN. Daimler Group is a Columbus developer founded 1983 that LinkedIn lists at 11-50 employees; the entity-name match is inferred, not confirmed by a filing.

Tractor Supply's FY2020 10-K (Brentwood, TN) reports about 20,000 full-time and 21,000 part-time team members as of December 26, 2020. JobsOhio metrics show a Logistics and Distribution project with 0 jobs retained, consistent with the new Navarre, OH distribution center.

Comet Processing, Inc. (Delaware) appears in Post Holdings' FY2023 10-K Exhibit 21 as a subsidiary and as a d/b/a of Michael Foods, Inc.; Post (St. Louis, MO) reported 11,430 employees as of November 1, 2023. The specific Ohio project behind the FY2023 Economic Development Grant (0 jobs retained, so a new site) was not identified in this pass.
